answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the nebula graph and each risks its bond. Because the quartz release is published with every signature, the velvet audit publishes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 8 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 27 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
